messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Breastfeeding:
Low levels of sertraline and its breakdown products pass into breast milk.
A pooled analysis of 53 mother and infant pairs was conducted.
Exclusively breastfed infants had an average of 2% of the sertraline levels measured in their mothers' blood.
The levels ranged from 0% to 15%.
No side effects were seen in those infants.
There is no information on whether sertraline affects milk production.
Talk with your doctor about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for treatment.
Children:
Sertraline is approved for OCD in children aged 6 to 17 years.
It is not known to be safe and effective in children under 6.
It is not known to be safe and effective for any other condition in this age group.
Children and teenagers taking sertraline should be monitored for worsening symptoms and suicidal thoughts.
This monitoring is especially important early in treatment and when the dose changes.
Their weight and growth should be checked.
Older adults:
Older adults clear sertraline more slowly.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "approved for", "OCD in children 6 to 17 years"]

The relation 'approved for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is officially approved by regulatory authorities for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has approval status': The subject drug has the regulatory approval status specified by the object entity.
B. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
C. 'has availability': The subject drug is available under the regulatory status specified by the object entity (for example prescription only or over the counter).
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
